coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Channel Mission Bay
record.summary: Channel Mission Bay is a 315-unit apartment building at 185 Channel St in Mission Bay, developed by DOB Mission Bay LP with LaHue and Associates and now managed by UDR. No source found in this pass states a completion date directly; DataSF Assessor tax-roll data shows the parcel's assessed improvement value rising from $0 in the 2012 roll to $30M in 2013 and $94M in 2014, with 316 units first recorded in the 2015 roll, consistent with construction substantially finishing around 2014.

changes.text: Gus's Community Market opened its fourth family-owned San Francisco store on Dec 26, 2018, at 1101 4th St, the ground floor of the Channel Mission Bay apartment building at 4th and Channel, with a deli, butcher counter, cafe and grocery.

The Market Hall, a 10,000 sq ft gourmet grocery and food hall from Primo Hospitality Group, opened at 1101 4th St in the Channel Mission Bay building's ground floor in 2016; its Yelp listing now shows it closed, though no closure date was found. Gus's Community Market later opened in the same unit.

open_questions: No source found in this pass states a specific completion/opening date for this building; the 2014 date here is inferred from Assessor tax-roll value trends, not a stated event, and is flagged accordingly.

This parcel's own DataSF Assessor 'year_property_built' field is blank in every roll year checked -- unlike most other Mission Bay buildings in this pass, the Assessor does not give a direct construction year for this parcel.

Several real-estate listing aggregators (Zillow, Trulia, Apartments.com) state the building was 'built in 2013,' which is consistent with the Assessor's value trend, but these pages returned 403/blocked responses when fetched directly in this session and their exact wording could not be independently confirmed, so that claim is not used as a citation here.

The building's developer (DOB Mission Bay LP) and the LaHue and Associates/UDR project pages already cited in this project's geometry file (data/manual/mission_bay_channel.geojson) do not themselves give an opening date -- confirmed by this pass's own re-check of the geometry file's accuracy_caveat, which already notes 'Opening year not confirmed by any source found.'
